metadata.question: Was the total rainfall in Grafton, New South Wales, greater than the total rainfall in Canberra from January 15, 2020 to January 21, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) daily precipitation dataset - Date range: January 15-21, 2020 - Two locations: Grafton, NSW (~-29.69°S, 152.93°E) and Canberra (~-35.28°S, 149.13°E) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed - CHIRPS is a precipitation product - Just sum the precipitation values over the date range 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If precipitation = 0, that's a real answer (no rain) - C1: If no images found in collection - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels (unlikely for CHIRPS which has global coverage) - C3: If result is null/undefined/NaN - Compare Grafton total vs Canberra total for final A/B answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const grafton = ee.Geometry.Point([152.93, -29.69]); const canberra = ee.Geometry.Point([149.13, -35.28]); const startDate = '2020-01-15'; const endDate = '2020-01-22'; // Exclusive end date // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Collection size: ${collectionSize} images`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No data found for the specified period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over the period const totalPrecip = chirps.select('precipitation').sum(); // 4. Calculate total rainfall for both locations const graftonResult = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: grafton, scale: 5566, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const canberraResult = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: canberra, scale: 5566, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const graftonTotal = graftonResult.getInfo(); const canberraTotal = canberraResult.getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Grafton total rainfall: ${graftonTotal !== null ? graftonTotal.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm`); console.log(`Canberra total rainfall: ${canberraTotal !== null ? canberraTotal.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm`); if (graftonTotal === null || canberraTotal === null || isNaN(graftonTotal) || isNaN(canberraTotal)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid result."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (graftonTotal < 0 || canberraTotal < 0 || graftonTotal > 1000 || canberraTotal > 1000) { console.log("Invalid precipitation values detected."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (graftonTotal > canberraTotal) { console.log(`Grafton (${graftonTotal.toFixed(2)} mm) > Canberra (${canberraTotal.toFixed(2)} mm)`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Grafton (${graftonTotal.toFixed(2)} mm) <= Canberra (${canberraTotal.toFixed(2)} mm)`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
